spans.text: Keep secrets out of logs, code, and commit text.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly addresses keeping secrets out of logs, code, and commit text, which is a clear privacy and data protection measure relevant to a coding agent context.

spans.text: Do not perform destructive actions without explicit approval.
spans.note: The prompt includes multiple safety-oriented instructions: requiring explicit approval before destructive actions, preserving unrelated local changes, running checks/tests, and implementing minimal focused changes. These collectively promote tool and action safety.

spans.text: Follow instruction priority: system > developer > user > tool feedback.
spans.note: The prompt establishes a clear instruction priority hierarchy (system > developer > user > tool feedback) and requires explicit approval for destructive actions, preserving user control over consequential decisions. The workflow also emphasizes understanding the request first before acting.
